scope: one bounded source-only review of five frozen source0.79 files; not final-diff or runtime/film acceptance

packet.prompt: Review ONLY the supplied source as static code; do not execute tests, callbacks, geometry, renderer, browser or any tools. Identify at most 3 concrete correctness defects in canonical ownership serialization/observation. Each finding must include exact file/snippet, realistic triggering data admitted by the upstream contracts, and a narrow safe fix. Do not manufacture approvals or remove needs-source-prop-binding. Known limitations (nonrotating tools only, production blocked, sampled rather than continuous error bound, preflight lacks actual actor breakpoints) are not new bugs by themselves. Important: the own hand-<side> is a defs group in rig.ts, compiler animates its world-space transform, and the canonical palm <use> intentionally references that animated group. No additional transform is needed. compileSourceOwnership supplies whole original source/narration/paint hashes and validates source context. Examine duplicate rendering, actual canonical sample consumption and mutations/mismatch that can be silently ignored. If no concrete defect is established return findings:[] rather than speculative changes. Return JSON {findings:[{severity,file,evidence,trigger,fix}],limitations:[]}; concise.

findings.evidence: renderOwnershipLayer checks c.ownershipPaint?.filter(p=>p.sourceId===item.source.id&&hash(p)===item.paintHash).length!==1, but never compares hash(item.paint) with item.paintHash. Serialization directly uses item.paint.grips.filter(g=>g.depth==='before-entity').map(g=>palms.get(g.gripId)).join('') and the corresponding after-entity expression.
findings.trigger: Start with a valid two-person handoff compilation. The returned CompiledOwnership remains mutable despite the ReadonlyMap: change item.paint.grips[1].gripId to item.paint.grips[0].gripId without updating paintHash. The guard passes, and serialization emits the same palm group/ID twice while omitting the other palm. allIds checks initial palm construction, not these repeated insertions.
findings.fix: Before consuming paint, require hash(item.paint)===item.paintHash in addition to the existing authoritative shot-plan comparison. Serialize the checked snapshot and reject mismatches with needs-source-prop-binding.

findings.evidence: renderOwnershipLayer consumes for(const [i,sample] of item.bake.samples.entries()) and sample.activeGripIds.includes(grip.id) directly. Its sample-presence check is !item.bake.samples.length; it does not use ownership-bake-query.ts's endpoint, phase-boundary, or exact phase-annotation validation.
findings.trigger: A valid compilation has a world-to-held boundary at 500ms. Delete that retained sample from the writable bake.samples array while preserving endpoints and later held samples. Existing layer guards still pass, but the palm becomes visible at the next retained held sample rather than the original 500ms contact. ownershipBakeAt would reject the missing boundary.
findings.fix: Expose and reuse the query module's validated retained-sample snapshot before generating layer calls. Reject missing boundaries and incorrect ownership annotations. Keep the canonical palm use referencing the animated hand group; add no palm transform.

findings.evidence: ownershipRelationFrames checks if(partId!==item.source.partId||item.bake.startMs!==shot.startMs||item.bake.endMs!==shot.endMs||item.version!==OWNERSHIP_RENDER_VERSION), but never checks item.shotHash or membership of item.source in the supplied shot's canonical sources.
findings.trigger: Two independently valid revisions of a shot retain the same partId, clock span, and render version but have different authored ownership positions. Pass revision A's compiled map with revision B's shot. The function silently returns A's centers as B's relation observations, although renderOwnershipLayer would reject the revision mismatch.
findings.fix: Before collecting sample times, require item.shotHash===hash(shot) and exact canonical source membership using the existing layer guard's source comparison. Preserve needs-source-prop-binding on mismatch.
